description.en: "Line", "primary offer", and "service class" all refer to the same thing: the base tariff plan a SIM card is on (for example Red or Yooz). A customer's service class determines which bundles and offers they are eligible to buy.
description.ar: «الخط» و«العرض الأساسي» و«فئة الخدمة» كلها تشير إلى نفس الشيء: خطة التعرفة الأساسية للشريحة (مثل رد أو يوز). فئة الخدمة تحدد أي باقات وعروض يمكن للزبون شراءها.
description.ckb: «هێڵ» و«ئۆفەری سەرەکی» و«پۆلی خزمەتگوزاری» هەموویان هەمان شت دەگەیەنن: پلانی بنەڕەتی سیمکارت (وەک ڕێد یان یووز). پۆلی خزمەتگوزاری دیاری دەکات کام پاکێج بۆ کڕیار بەردەستە.
description.kmr: «Xet», «ofera bingehîn» û «çîna xizmetê» hemû heman tişt in: plana bingehîn a SIM kartê (wek Red an Yooz). Çîna xizmetê diyar dike ka kîjan pakêj ji bo xerîdar berdest in.

attributes.review_note: From docs/02 §2 terminology example. ar/ckb/kmr machine-drafted — needs native review. ⚠ RETIRED 2026-09-12. Reason: a usefulness probe found the invented placeholders ranking #1 on 6 of 24 realistic customer questions and in the top 3 on 11 of 24 — they outranked the 50 real FEBRA bundles because they were the only entities with BOTH aliases and how_to, so they were the richest documents in the index. Worst observed case: "how do I subscribe to Weekly TikTok?" returned bundle_1603 subscribe at fused score 1.00, offering the INVENTED code "dial *321*2# or send NET2 to 1234". The invented Shukran definition was also the material a 3B model borrowed to fabricate a definition of "Eshrat Omar". Retired rather than deleted so the record and the gold-set history survive; `status: retired` is excluded from every query by buildFilter(). To bring one back, author it from a real source and set status accordingly. Service class — invented placeholder definition.
